# Review Changes in a Proposal

Review changes within the selected document on **Proposals**. Read its Rationale, supported evidence and Comments, then prepare Apply using the current command readiness. There is no separate Review Changes page.

See [Review a Proposal](guide:review-a-proposal) and [Apply to FieldWorks](guide:apply-to-fieldworks).
